user.title: Add MoLight entities
user.description: Create a single virtual entity, or discover existing entities to wrap in bulk.

menu_options.assign_sensor: Assign a sensor to several lights

assign_sensor.title: Assign a sensor to lights
assign_sensor.description: Attach one virtual sensor to several virtual lights at once. Pick the kind of sensor to assign.

assign_occupancy.title: Assign an occupancy sensor
assign_occupancy.description: Choose the occupancy sensor and how it should drive the lights. Regular occupancy turns lights on and off; maintain only holds an already-on light on while occupied.

assign_illuminance.title: Assign an illuminance sensor
assign_illuminance.description: Choose the illuminance sensor and how it should drive the lights.

assign_schedule.title: Assign a schedule sensor
assign_schedule.description: Choose the schedule sensor and how it should drive the lights.

assign_lights.title: Choose the lights
assign_lights.description: Lights already using this sensor are pre-selected. Add lights to assign it, or deselect a pre-selected light to remove it — the final selection is the complete set that will use this sensor.

discover_occupancy.title: Discover occupancy sensors
discover_occupancy.description: Select the occupancy/motion sensors to wrap in virtual occupancy sensors, created with default settings you can edit afterwards. Sensors already wrapped by MoLight (and disabled ones) are hidden.

data.affix_prefix: Prefix (optional) — added before each, applied verbatim (e.g. "Auto ")
data.affix_suffix: Suffix (optional) — added after each, applied verbatim (e.g. " (auto)")

discover_illuminance.title: Discover illuminance sensors
discover_illuminance.description: Select the illuminance (lux) sensors to wrap in virtual illuminance sensors, created with default settings you can edit afterwards. Sensors already wrapped by MoLight (and disabled ones) are hidden.

data.affix_prefix: Prefix (optional) — added before each, applied verbatim (e.g. "Auto ")
data.affix_suffix: Suffix (optional) — added after each, applied verbatim (e.g. " (auto)")

discover_light.title: Discover lights
discover_light.description: Select the lights to wrap in virtual lights, created with default settings. Add occupancy, illuminance or schedule references afterwards via each entity's options. Lights already wrapped by MoLight (and disabled ones) are hidden.

data.maintain_occupancy_entity: Maintain occupancy sensor (optional) — keeps an already-on light on while occupied, never turns it on
data.hold_entities: Keep-on entities (optional) — auto-off is suspended while any of these is on
data.false_detection_off_delay: Turn-off delay after a false detection (s)
data.auto_on_brightness: Auto-on brightness (%, optional) — used only when the light turns on automatically
data.effect_timeout: Effect warning duration (s, 0 = off) — blink/dip before auto-off
data.effect_brightness: Effect brightness (%) — 0 blinks the lights fully off

data.warn_brightness: Warn brightness (%, optional) — blank keeps the current brightness

confirm_entity_id.title: Entity ID already exists
confirm_entity_id.description: An entity with the ID `{entity_id}` already exists, so Home Assistant will create `{entity_id}_2` instead. Set an Entity ID on the previous step to avoid this.

error.lights_required: At least one light is required.
error.light_timeout_too_short: The turn-off timeout must be at least the timeout of the selected occupancy sensor.
error.occupancy_timeout_too_long: This timeout exceeds the turn-off timeout of a virtual light that uses this sensor.
error.window_incomplete: Incomplete window: both the start and the end need a time and/or a sun event (or leave the window fully empty).
error.entity_id_conflict: That entity ID is already in use. Choose a different one, or leave it blank to derive one from the name.

abort.no_candidates: No new entities were found — everything eligible is already wrapped by a MoLight entity (or is disabled).
abort.discovery_done: Created {count} virtual MoLight entities. They use default settings; edit any of them via its options.
abort.no_lights: There are no virtual lights to assign this sensor to. Create a virtual light first.
abort.assign_done: Assigned the sensor to {assigned} light(s) and removed it from {removed}.
abort.assign_done_skipped: Assigned the sensor to {assigned} light(s) and removed it from {removed}. Skipped (turn-off timeout shorter than the sensor's timeout): {skipped}.

options.regular: Regular — turns lights on and off with occupancy
options.maintain: Maintain — only holds an already-on light on while occupied

options.entity_id: Entity ID only — keep the original name (avoids a name clash's entity ID collision)
options.name: Name — also changes the entity ID

options.follow: Follow — turn on at window start, off at window end
options.gate: Gate — occupancy only works inside the window

options.control: Control — dark gates turn-on, bright turns lights off
options.gate: Gate only — dark gates turn-on, bright never turns lights off
